name: Prey
description: Explore Talos I together. CoopPrototype adds co-op to Prey (2017) as a Chairloader mod: every player keeps their own Morgan, with the campaign, enemies, devices and physics shared through a host.

setup.title: Prey
setup.detail: Install Prey (2017) from your Steam library.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts it in the Mods folder of the game. Chairloader 1.3.4 must be installed on the game first.

hostSteps: Install Chairloader 1.3.4 on Prey with its own manager first (the mod is a Chairloader mod and is made for that version), then download the mod above.
Start Prey through Chairloader and switch the Coop Prototype mod on in its manager.
In the main menu choose Multiplayer, then Host Game: pick a name, the capacity (2 to 16), the port (27015 UDP by default) and who may join.
Share your address with your friends: open the port on your router for play over the Internet.
joinSteps: Install Chairloader 1.3.4 on Prey, download the mod above (the same version as the host's) and start Prey through Chairloader with the mod on.
In the main menu choose Multiplayer: pick a game in the Server Browser, or join the host's address directly.
Follow the join overlay until the host's world is loaded. Each player needs their own Chairloader profile.

items.name: Host and join
items.detail: Up to 16 players through a host, by address or from the LAN server browser. Everyone needs the same game, Chairloader and mod version.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs the mod in the game's Mods folder and updates it when a new version is released.

items.name: One Morgan per player
items.detail: Each player keeps their own character and inventory, saved to their account.

items.name: Shared campaign
items.detail: Story progress, enemies, devices and physics results are decided by the host and shared.
